title: ClayCode CC8 Observed Transition Closure
summary: CC8 refines CC-RC1.2 into an OPEN CC-RC1.3 Observed Transition Closure Capsule: trusted compiler-derived static semantic envelope; runtime observed dependency/effect trace checked as a subset; typed object/predicate/invariant/temporal/capability witnesses; fail-closed escalation for unknown dynamic effects; and durable idempotent effect intent before external release.
architecture_candidate: canonical semantic op -> trusted static dependency/effect envelope -> model/reader projection + Gamma -> fully interposed observed trace -> trace-subset proof -> typed freshness/invariant/capability validation -> internal commit or durable effect-intent commit -> external capability-gated idempotent release -> effect/outcome/reentry receipts

cross_branch_links.clay: HSCK-G7 asymmetric coordination consumes trusted predicate/invariant/dependency witnesses; unknown coverage fails closed.
cross_branch_links.frank: Cycle-3 hybrid workspace freshness can encode channel revisions/regime dependencies as OTCC witnesses instead of global age/root alone.
cross_branch_links.gwt: Causal freshness/re-entry metadata maps to temporal/episode witnesses; receipt presence remains measurement plumbing rather than evidence strength.
cross_branch_links.hyperposition: ADD/RETRACT/REPLACE/COMPENSATE remain delta semantics independent of invariant-interference coordination topology and external authority.
cross_branch_links.emergenz: OTCC receipts may make interventions/replay measurable, but do not by themselves prove emergence or consciousness.
